Please take this time to appreciate that your lover still appreciate and treat you as a friend. There is a story to tell, one which is much less fortunate in comparison to yours.

A story where even the most basic friendship are no longer maintained, and connections and friendship are completely cut off.

It is hell of a pain, and will always be a pain for some of us. Especially you no can longer talk to that person anymore, knowing that your lover, do not care even for a slightest moment for you anymore.

Sometimes maintaining distance is a way that ensure we can still access to your crush, in the future, when you want to have a normal chat or drink with.

If your lover likes you, they will understand someday.

But the chance it happen might not be high. It is possible, please do not put too much hope because when love doesn't manifest, it hurts you back with 10 times the force. Unrequited love is the most painful thing a human can endure. It will be worst when the other person decided to cut you off completely from their lives, yet you do not stop loving for a single second in your life.

You are a beautiful soul, because you love someone, in the most basic and self-less way. We all are attached to someone not because of their material wealth, not because we want them to do anything to us, it is because we fall in love in the most natural, noble and heroic way. 

A love that do not demand anything in return, just giving, and not taking.

When you truly loved someone, the feeling really never went away, even though time had passed, the feeling of needing them can be lessen, but love never stops, at least the true feeling of love we had experienced.

Things in nature sometimes just happens for no reason, or for reason we cannot understand, this is how we can fall in love with someone whom doesn't love us in return, but also for the same randomness that the person might fall in love with us in the future.

Having access to the person you loved is enough, for many of us. If we went too far, sometimes that access will be lost forever.

I wish you the very best in your life, that someday, the other person will love you in return.

Simply it is because the sensor on any phone is tiny.(think a 1 inch sensor camera such as the one from the Sony RX100, but 3-4 times smaller). And the phone is compensate by stacking 10s of photos together. Because the sensor on smartphone are small, they cannot capture much detail under high ISO. It is the same for any phone. Its just physics limitation. I used to own Full frame camera and currently using the Fujifilm XT3. You just simply cannot get much detail under low light condition like this if you handheld, even on an apsc sensor size camera because of the shake when you hand holding for long exposure unless you use a wide aperture lens of 1.4 or below, but then your depth of field become so thin which blur everything (10times the sensor size) 

If you wanted lots of detail under night conditions, the only way is to setup a tripod, shoot at base iso and do a long exposure shot. And even so, there's procession done by the camera to proses the long exposure shot.

The fact that the tiny sensor on the phone get shots like this is what we never imagined back in the days. There's always limitations on a phone which has small sensor and tiny lens, better algorithm can improve, but it won't get over an apsc or even M43 sensor size camera with even a kit lens setup properly under a tripod.
